answer_summary: For U-235 + n -> Rb-93 + Cs-140 + 3n, the fragments contain 233 bound nucleons. Exact binding-energy accounting gives 233*8.45 - 235*7.59 = 185.20 MeV, reported as 185 MeV to three significant figures.
assumptions: The graph maxima are read as mass numbers 93 and 140; the preceding part's same-group condition and standard periodic-table data identify Rb-93 (Z=37) and Cs-140 (Z=55).
Standard positive nuclear binding-energy accounting is used: released energy equals total product binding energy minus total reactant binding energy.
The printed binding energies are treated as exact stipulated values, and all free-neutron binding energies are zero exactly as instructed by the problem.
